item.title: Tank, jet, new monuments coming to Ocala veterans’ park
item.description: The Ocala-Marion County Veterans Memorial Park is set for a significant update that will include new plaques, monuments, signs, parking, and static displays like a jet, tank, and Humvee. Read more: Tank, jet, new monuments coming to Ocala veterans’ park

item.title: James F. Nenno
item.description: James Nenno's passions were golf, bowling and the Redskins. He and Hilda enjoyed square dancing for over 40 years and loved to travel. Read more: James F. Nenno

item.title: Ann Marie Barlow
item.description: Ann Barlow will be remembered for for her love good deals at yard sales, of nature, animals, and listening to classic country music, She especially loved visits with her family and grandchildren. Read more: Ann Marie Barlow

item.title: Former interim superintendent taking over permanent role atop Marion Schools
item.description: Dr. Danielle Brewer has officially transitioned from interim to permanent superintendent of Marion County Public Schools after a unanimous vote by the school board to approve a two-year contract last week. Read more: Former interim superintendent taking over permanent role atop Marion Schools

item.title: Kurt Stoor
item.description: Kurt Stoor will be remembered for his steady presence, his appreciation for life’s simple pleasures, and the love he shared with those closest to him. Read more: Kurt Stoor

item.title: Deliver driver sues Ocala firetruck manufacturer over forklift fall
item.description: A delivery driver is suing an Ocala-based fire truck manufacturer following an incident where he was allegedly forced to jump from a trailer to avoid being crushed by a falling load. Read more: Deliver driver sues Ocala firetruck manufacturer over forklift fall

item.title: Godfrey Livingston Weir
item.description: Godfrey Weir and his wife received the “Pillars of the Community” award for their service. He enjoyed repairing cars and caring for his diverse home garden. Read more: Godfrey Livingston Weir

item.title: American bald eagle at Stone Creek in Ocala
item.description: This American bald eagle was sitting on the roof of a home in Stone Creek in Ocala, enjoying a beautiful day. Thanks to Sue Perry for sharing! Read more: American bald eagle at Stone Creek in Ocala

item.title: I think SR 200 traffic is unbearable
item.description: "The amount of traffic on State Road 200 is now unbearable. If schools, parks and activities are included in the infrastructure, than it might be ok, but traffic will be so congested and horrible. Sad to see these horse farms and trees, let alone turtle habitats, that were probably destroyed building this project. And people wonder why we have droughts." - A Dunnellon resident shares her opinion. Read more: I think SR 200 traffic is unbearable

item.title: Blasa Nidia Gutierrez de Diaz
item.description: Blasa Diaz will be remembered for her kindness, resilience, and the love she poured into her family and community. She found joy in preparing meals that brought people together, especially for her family. Read more: Blasa Nidia Gutierrez de Diaz
